rules: Tuning dimensions are non-canon gameplay priors, not biological or moral scores.
Species identifier is not a valid direct input to political/military escalation.
Culture supplies learned/contextual priors and never forces behavior.
Faction/polity doctrine applies only when the actor actually represents that faction/polity.
Government and leader policy may temporarily override broad cultural expectations.
Force balance, logistics, exhaustion and objectives can reverse a normal doctrinal preference.
Individual captains/commanders still require personality, orders and authority state.
Unknown context produces uncertainty rather than a default Human/Federation doctrine.
